pr_title: drivers: dma: fix error when suspend and resume not supported
pr_body:
update dma loop test to avoid error in the suspend/resume
testcase when the dma drivers does not provide the service.
The test_loop_suspend_resume function exits immediately
with transfer_count set to a oversized value, so that
dma is stopped and testcase ends properly.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44106

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu <francois.ramu@st.com>
pr_comments: @FRASTM see #43984

Let's keep the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/43984 instead
to fix the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44106 

To avoid spurious DMA interrupt  like in the tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer/  test_dma_m2m_loop_suspend_resume    :
```
E: Transfer Error.                                         
I: tc: 0, ht: 0, te: 0, gi: 0    
```
the dma_stm32_irq_handler could return immediately if the DMA channel is disabled at this time
```
	/* do not continue if channel is not enabled*/
	if (!LL_DMA_IsEnabledChannel(dma, dma_stm32_id_to_stream(id))) {
		return;
	}
```

During the tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer/test_dma_m2m_loop, the immediately after the dma_start, the irq is pending before the dma suspend comes. The channel is disabled and irq flag are off when _isr_wrapper arrives.
I think its fair to bail on the ISR if its stopped

issue_context.title: test of dma drivers fails on dma_m2m_loop_test
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
the testcase : tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer fails on all stm32 target boards on the test_loop_suspend_resume()

After the merge of the https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/43738/ the testcase fails because the stm32 dma has no suspend/resume mode, 
Probably also failing on any target where the dma_api_suspend suspend; 	dma_api_resume resume; are not implemented ( -ENOSYS If not implemented. returned) as described in the include/drivers/dma.h 


Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - all the stm32 targets that can execute the tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer test.
 - this comes as a regression after the change in the test_loop_suspend_resume() function of the tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer/src/test_dma_loop.c

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. west build -p auto -b nucleo_wb55rg tests/drivers/dma/loop_transfer/
3. west flash
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
```
START - test_dma_m2m_loop_suspend_resume

this platform do not support the dma channel

===================================================================
```
